scope: Exactly three written statements: zero-argument Lock/RLock call on a lexical identifier/selector receiver; matching written deferred Unlock/RUnlock call on same lexical spelling; explicit bounded return expressions. Does not prove mutex type, receiver identity at runtime, helper effects, completion or concurrency safety.
separate_profiles: Existing sole-return profile remains separate and its return_contract is unchanged. Normal model authoring/native selector and defaults do not automatically use this new profile.

language_semantics.summary: A defer statement evaluates function value/arguments when reached, while postponing the function invocation. The source renderer records written statement order and does not claim an immediate second call or successful runtime completion.

includes: Fake Lock/Unlock definitions with panic do not imply mutex behavior and are not executed
